errorInfo.title: Shortcode delimiter not separated by a space
errorInfo.message: A shortcode's delimiters must be separated from its content by whitespace. Write `{{< fa plus >}}` — a space after `{{<` and a space before `>}}` — rather than `{{<fa plus>}}`.
hints: Both delimiters need the space. Adding it to only one of them leaves the shortcode unparseable.

Quarto 1 accepted the tight spelling because it matched shortcodes with a regular expression. Quarto 2 parses them, and requires the space so that `{{` stays unambiguous with template syntaxes such as Jinja and Handlebars.
`qmd-syntax-helper convert -r q-2-52 -i <file>` rewrites both delimiters for you.
